model: SDV5 VRF BACnet Gateway GW-BAC (outdoor unit device)
applies_to: Sinclair SDV5 VRF outdoor units reached over the XYE bus through a GW-BAC gateway.
summary: The GW-BAC publishes every SDV5 outdoor unit it finds as its own BACnet IP device with the same 13 read-only objects: mode, on/off and alarm status, ambient temperature, compressor frequencies and discharge temperatures, pressures, error code and fan speeds. Outdoor units cannot be commanded through the gateway; control goes through the indoor unit devices.
default_device_instance: Network number x 10000 + port x 1000 + 100 + outdoor unit address
notes: Each outdoor unit is a separate BACnet device. Device instance = network number x 10000 + 485 port x 1000 + 100 + outdoor address (0-31). Ports are 0-3 (0 = the port next to the Ethernet jack).
Object instances are the same in every outdoor unit device; only the device instance changes.
All objects are read-only. Not every model supports every object.
Malfunction Code numbers map to display codes (1-20 = A0-AU, 21-40 = b0-bU, and so on) in the manual's error code table.
'Ambient Temperatue' is spelled as printed in the manual.
Indoor unit devices from the same gateway are in sinclair/sdv5-gw-bac.

source.title: GW-BAC Commercial Air Conditioners SDV5 (user manual), 4-2 Object List for Outdoor Units

integration.summary: Once the gateway has an IP address and a unique BACnet network number, each outdoor unit appears as its own device at network x 10000 + port x 1000 + 100 + address. Read status, alarm and error code for monitoring; all objects are read-only.
setup: Default IP address is 192.168.1.8; configuration is done from a web browser at that address (user admin).
Set a BACnet network number of 2-254 that no other gateway or device uses; it takes effect after a restart.
Outdoor unit device instance = network number x 10000 + port x 1000 + 100 + outdoor address (0-31).
gotchas: Outdoor unit devices are read-only; start/stop and setpoints are written to the indoor unit devices.
Re-addressing an outdoor unit or moving it to another port changes its device instance.
